# Characteristic: what the model was built from. Governed by R1-R7 of

# Merged from models_tree/runA and models_tree/runB under the faceted design of
# MODELS_AXES.md. The two runs' lineage spines survive; their root sets are taken
# network', `Embedding model' and `Factorization model' were axis values wearing
# lineage clothing. Named design families whose defining property moved to an
# axis are KEPT (VAE, Normalizing flow, Group-equivariant CNN, NTM, Liquid state
# machine) -- that distinction is the whole merge.
# connectivity / topology / attributes hold pipe-separated node_ids from
# node PINS. A node INHERITS its parent's pinned values; a value is recorded only
# where the node changes or ADDS one. Empty therefore means "same as parent",
# computation, no-memory, deterministic-latent, non-invertible) are never pinned.
# `characteristic' is the principle dividing THIS node's children, and is filled
# only where a sibling set is produced by division (R4/R6). `depth' is the
# SHORTEST path to a root. No count columns.
